48.original: Lali-yet another recording device has arrived-ho. Whatever Konogg's up to, as long as he keeps sending these, we can assume he's safe and well. Anyway, here you go.

49.original: Um, Chief? Can I speak with you for a moment?

51.original: It's Glagg. I ran into him just now, and he was behaving oddly...

52.original: Just when you think he's angry, he suddenly bursts into tears. And the next thing you know, he's talking with you like you're an old friend.

53.original: Ah, that... He's been that way since the meeting.

54.original: But I'll sort him out, so don't worry. Thanks for bringing me word, and let me know if you notice anything else.

55.original: It seems Glagg's condition isn't common knowledge yet. But it's only a matter of time if it continues to worsen, like it seems to be doing.

56.original: Sorry, I'm saying all of this out loud, but it's not your problem to deal with. Just stay focused on the rebuilding─that's how you'll best help us.

57.original: You obtain a message from Konogg.

58.original: The message can be viewed in your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Portable Archive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which is available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
